candidates.change_summary: Replace 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' with 'balances[owner] = totalSupply;' so the owner's balance after NETM becomes totalSupply instead of totalDistributed.
Delete the entire body of modifier onlyOwner, making it do nothing, so NETM becomes callable by anyone, changing who can set the initial balance.

Delete the line 'owner = msg.sender;' so NETM no longer updates owner to msg.sender, potentially leaving owner unchanged and affecting future privileged calls, but more importantly for this target, any subsequent call to NETM will still set balances[owner] using the existing owner variable, which may differ from msg.sender.
Replace 'owner = msg.sender;' with 'owner = address(0);' so owner is set to zero address, causing balances[address(0)] to be set to totalDistributed, observable via balanceOf(address(0)).

Replace 'require(msg.sender == owner);' with 'require(msg.sender != owner);' in the onlyOwner modifier, inverting access control so NETM becomes callable only by non-owners, changing who can set balances[owner].
Replace 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' with 'balances[msg.sender] = totalDistributed;' so the distribution goes to the caller instead of the owner variable.

Replace 'totalDistributed' with 'totalSupply' in the statement 'totalDistributed = (totalDistributed + (_amount));' (not applicable here; this is a summary edit inside distr, but distr is not in allowed units). Skipping. Instead, replace 'balances[owner] = totalDistributed;' with 'balances[owner] = 0;' so owner gets zero balance.
